description.value: Long Table Distillery is a craft distillery and pub on Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver, producing a range of gins, vodkas, and liqueurs under their own label. Beyond spirits retail, they offer hands-on cocktail-making classes and a distinctive Sushi + Cocktail Making Class in partnership with a local sushi restaurant. It sits in the heart of downtown Vancouver, making it a potential stop for cyclists exploring the nearby seawall corridor.
